C1518.title: PyPI Package 'lightning' Hit by Supply Chain Attack, Stealing Developer Credentials and Poisoning Repositories
C1518.summary: The deep learning package 'lightning' on the Python Package Index (PyPI), with over a million downloads, was embedded with malicious code designed to steal GitHub Tokens and cloud credentials, and further poison other code repositories. This incident severely threatens the entire crypto development ecosystem that relies on open-source libraries.
